description: Wever Briefs: the deep brief behind the free fair-value lookup for one prediction market. Inputs: platform (kalshi or polymarket) and market (ticker, slug or market URL). Returns the estimated fair price, every input used (engine estimate, compared price, Kalshi, Polymarket and Novig quotes where available, and a direct venue read), the spread in points against each quoted price and a reasoning summary, with the engine’s own reasoning when it produced this exact estimate. One market per call. POST /api/fair-value-brief. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns one brief with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/briefs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/briefs/.

market.description: One market: a Kalshi market ticker, a Polymarket market slug, or that market’s URL on the named platform.

platform.description: The platform that lists the market.
